dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature featuring a distinct V-shaped notch approximately 50% of the distance from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius and an obtuse shape classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex anterior margin oriented posteriorly relative to the primary longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height of the fin exceeds the visible horizontal base width, resulting in a ratio of approximately 0.8:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex parabolic arc defining a prominent melon bulb on the anterior-dorsal surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust rostrum extending from the melon inflection point with a low length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch is present on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; scattered dark markings are visible on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A single pectoral fin is visible on the lower right lateral side, showing a broad base and tapered tip.
